description: AIGID防災訓練2022による被災地の航空写真(株式会社パスコ) [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 株式会社パスコ. 本データセットは、AIGIDが主催する研究会による防災訓練2022のためのダミーデータになります。 パブリックで公開しておりますが、一般にご利用いただくことはできませんのでご了承ください。 このたびの災害においてお亡くなりになられた方に謹んで哀悼の意を表します。 また被災された方々に心よりお見舞いを申し上げます。 AIGID防災訓練202... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 株式会社パスコ. Its tags are AIGID防災訓練2022. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, jpeg. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
